description: Per-block extrinsic and event counts for the last N blocks (1-10) on the Bittensor (Subtensor) Substrate blockchain using direct JSON-RPC. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_subtensor_block_events when you need Events of a single Bittensor Subtensor block by block; crypto_subtensor_evm_activity when you need Bittensor EVM activity monitor: recent blocks, transaction. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: Number of recent finalized blocks to inspect (1-10, default 5)

name: crypto_subtensor_block_metrics
